note: Ledger for tests/browser_audit_regressions.cjs. A defect listed under 'open' MUST reproduce; a defect not listed MUST NOT. Either mismatch fails the run. The fix for a defect removes its id here in the same change. Probes trigger update checks the way a returning tab does; the 'online' event is avoided because the phone code redraws on it, which hid B2 and B3 in an early version of this suite.

defects.A1: Generate, then ban a suggested hero, then apply: the banned hero enters allied locks (ui.js apply handler)
defects.A2: Mobile Undo restores a ban without invalidating generated alternatives (mobile.js undo handler)
defects.A3: Clearing enemies leaves alternatives generated under the old constraints on screen (ui.js clear-enemies)
defects.A4: Removing a ban leaves alternatives generated under the old constraints on screen (ui.js unban)
defects.A5: GUARD: applying an alternative still works when nothing changed, and the applied picks have unique heroes and roles
defects.A6: GUARD: replacing one role (substitution) still works from current alternatives and records its own inputs
defects.A7: GUARD: a saved draft that already contains a banned locked hero is repaired on load; the ban and every other valid pick are kept
defects.A8: GUARD: when alternatives are cleared because inputs changed, the panel says why
defects.A9: GUARD: changing the combination size or the enemy lineup never leaves alternatives from the old inputs on screen
defects.A10: GUARD: when a failed publication check withholds recommendations, alternatives on screen are cleared and the panel says why
defects.A11: GUARD: 'Plan this pair' is disabled for a banned or enemy-picked hero, and even a forced click never locks it or deletes the ban
defects.A12: GUARD: a reviewed plan is checked against current bans even when the guidance packet has no strategic review; a banned hero is never locked
defects.A13: GUARD: when a search option (Order by, size, role, unsampled) clears alternatives, the panel names the search options, not picks or data
defects.B1: DESKTOP: failed official verification plus a failed bundle download rebuilds the engine as withheld but never redraws the main view (static_client.js catch path calls chrome() only)
defects.B2: PHONE: after 49 hours and a successful check with an unchanged bundle hash, the freshness label still reads Current (static_client.js success path updates chrome only; the label lives in the main view)
defects.B3: PHONE: failed official verification plus a failed bundle download rebuilds the engine as withheld but never redraws the phone main view
defects.C1: GUARD: statistics outside the 48-hour window are labelled as saved statistics on desktop and phone, with their original fetch date
defects.C2: GUARD: statistics fetched an hour ago are not labelled as saved (no over-flagging)
defects.C3: GUARD: a redraw caused by an evidence change never takes focus or text from a field the user is typing in, and the view still shows the new evidence
defects.C4: GUARD: when no editorial tier is active the phone Meta page says tiers are paused and why, and orders by role performance
defects.C5: GUARD: a redraw deferred while typing is not lost when a render replaces the focused field without a blur (WebKit behaviour); the next evidence change is still redrawn when focus leaves
defects.C6: GUARD: while recommendations are paused by a failed patch check, the phone status badge says Paused and keeps following the age of the statistics on screen
defects.C7: GUARD: a failed patch check on unchanged data never takes focus or text from the field being typed in
defects.C8: GUARD: a postponed redraw never swallows a click on the main view (it waits for the click to finish)
defects.C9: GUARD: typing into the desktop hero search keeps the caret, so the text is not reversed
defects.C10: GUARD: a focused select does not hold a withheld recommendation on screen; the view redraws and the select keeps focus
defects.C11: GUARD: going offline while typing on the phone keeps focus and every keystroke
defects.C12: GUARD: a redraw keeps the official patch-change search filter
defects.C13: GUARD: when the patch check succeeds and finds new official content, the phone badge says so and does not claim the check failed
defects.D1: GUARD: with one failed Statz hero page, collected roles keep their exact numbers, the failed role shows none, and the desktop source note states the gap
defects.D2: GUARD: with one failed Statz hero page, the phone status line states the gap
defects.E1: Composition search for five heroes blocks the main thread for longer than 500 ms (engine.generate called synchronously)
defects.E2: GUARD: alternatives computed in the worker are identical to the engine's own result for the same inputs
defects.E3: GUARD: where a worker cannot start, composition search still completes on the main thread and the result is current
defects.E4: GUARD: a result that finishes after the draft changed is discarded, and the page says why
defects.E5: GUARD: when two update checks overlap a slow offline save, the page never shows one publication while ranking from another
defects.E6: GUARD: a composition search that finishes while the user types elsewhere never takes their focus or text
defects.G1: The downloaded strategy review packet must carry every official change in the bundle, reference the loaded bundle by checksum and list the published brackets (was: zero official changes, mobile.js read B.official.changes)
defects.H1: Mobile Meta says reviewed tier guidance leads while no editorial tier is active (mobile.js guidedHome copy)
